title: Roommate, woman 61: sudden bad headache, numb face, slurred speech, 'she gets migraines'

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 1475 Haight Street, apartment 2. It's my roommate, she's 61.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She got a really bad headache all of a sudden, and now she says her face is numb and her speech is slurred.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does her face look different to you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The left side of her face looks kind of slack. She does get migraines, though.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About 45 minutes ago, before the headache started.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is she awake and breathing normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, she's lying on the couch with the lights off.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay with her.
